name: Swept by the Storm
source:
A blizzard is on the way! 

Jody is flying home from her first supply run on her own when she's knocked out of the sky by the storm's winds and into a part of the forest she's never explored. 

Can Jody get home before she's buried by the snow? Let's hope the spirits have mercy on her.

[From [url=https://denniyopi.itch.io/swept-by-the-storm]itch.io[/url]]
